statement: A BEST_EFFORT event's hand-off never blocks or logs on the request's thread: a full or closed queue drops the event and counts it, and a reporter on the listeners' own dispatcher logs how many each listener dropped since its last line, at most once per warning interval, through a conflated signal (no unbounded hand-off).
guards: runtime:DecisionListenersShutdownTest#a full queue drops without waiting on the log, which is written off the request's thread
